seed_rule: seed(d, j) = 2^62 + (int.from_bytes(sha256(TAG || A || R || bytes([d]) || j.to_bytes(2, 'big'))[:8], 'big') mod 2^62); TAG = tag, A = the approval record's bytes (sha256 approval_sha256), R = bytes.fromhex(beacon.randomness)

beacon.check: randomness = sha256(signature); the round can be fetched from any drand endpoint, e.g. https://api.drand.sh/<chain_hash>/public/<round>

file_format: npz (zip, members stored uncompressed in name order, timestamps 1980-01-01): det = np.packbits(detector bits, axis=1) uint8 (10000, ceil(m/8)), obs = observable 0 uint8 (10000,), seed = int64
